summary: Edible Garden AG filed an 8-K disclosing a September 30, 2026 Real Estate Purchase Contract with Iowa Shrimp Holdings, LLC to buy the Webster City, Iowa property housing its Prairie Hills facility for $6,325,000. Consideration is non-cash: 1,500 Series B Preferred shares ($1.5M agreed value, issued), 1,000 more at closing ($1.0M), and a $3.825M secured note paying 8% compounded daily, maturing five years out, mortgage-backed. A 20-day due diligence period runs from September 30, 2026, terminable at company discretion. Watch closing conditions, dilution and financing risk.
